scope: Paired 24-second virtual-clock engineering demo; no biological calibration, hardware, or physical-output claim.

attempts.failure: Runner treated an empty Rule feature mask as an error on a Core block intentionally skipped while the output-generation drain was pending.
attempts.notes: This was a runner-side startup-mask handling defect. It did not demonstrate a model, controller, safety, or scheduler failure. No complete report was written.

attempts.failure: The already-disarmed off condition reached finite-source EOF with three queued zero commands. The runner checked only for a pending transition/barrier and therefore skipped starting an EOF drain transaction.
attempts.notes: Fixed by starting RuntimeState.begin_recoverable_drain() at EOF even when the condition is already disarmed, and servicing until the barrier and command queue are clear. The safe-output policy and model parameters did not change.
Passed after the EOF drain fix. R4 repeats the paired run after clarifying measurement timestamps and adding negative cancellation/response tests.
Final packaged run. All 74 captured source/input hashes were unchanged.
